message:
I fixed the yen receipt, and the full suite now passes (18 of 18).

The cause was `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 JPY came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a zero-decimal list containing `JPY`, and amounts in those currencies are now shown as-is (`¥500`).

`formatMoney` is shared by invoices, payments, cart and admin, so yen amounts in those places will now show correctly too. No other test covers yen.
